editorial.blurb: Thattu brings authentic Kerala cuisine to Chicago with vibrant, soulful dishes made entirely from scratch—a warm, cozy gem that feels like dining in your grandmother's kitchen.
editorial.insiderTip: Make an online reservation and arrive a bit early for parking on Fletcher Avenue; even same-night bookings are often available, and the QR code ordering system makes things seamless.
tags: South Indian classics with modern twists
